review_contract.operation: One task review lifecycle contains immutable generations; each initial or post-fix ./forge review <task-id> generation composes one combined prompt and invokes the installed helper exactly once for quality, performance and security. A blocking complete generation publishes and blocks; only the selected clean generation certifies proof. review_contract.publication: Validate one content-addressed immutable generation and one small pointer through factory/schemas/review-set.json, with origin=combined, origin=rejection or origin=upgrade. generation_id is the lowercase SHA256 of canonical sorted compact UTF-8 JSON for all generation fields except generation_id; the file at reviews/generations/<generation_id>.json includes that ID and every read recomputes it. Require every existing ancestor to be a real non-symlink directory and every existing/new leaf to be a regular single-link file. Use an exclusive same-directory temp plus atomic hard-link/no-overwrite for generations; use same-directory temp plus atomic replace for selection. Publish via a complete temporary file and atomic no-overwrite: byte-identical retry succeeds and unequal same-ID collision refuses. Read back and validate the generation first, then atomically replace task-scoped reviews/selected.json. Fixed-only, interrupted, mixed, copied, stale or tampered attempts refuse without replacing the pointer. Pointer replacement is the publication commit point; failure before it preserves the old pointer, while later stamp failure keeps the committed selection for retry. Hold the existing cross-platform task lock with kind review-selection through read/validate/publish/final compare/pointer/stamp.

review_contract.success: The task pointer selects one immutable generation containing all actual ordered complete helper pass reports and three genuine lens records on one current delta_id binding. Complete blocking results publish and block; only selected clean certifies. forge task close skips review only for that selected clean current-delta generation. Fixed paths are never runtime proof, and no private prompt reconstruction, parallel registry, hostile-worker containment, nested review or story-wide duplicate exists.
review_contract.assessment_grammar: Each actual pass overall_explanation contains exactly one nonempty full-line BEGIN FORGE ASSESSMENT <lens>/END FORGE ASSESSMENT <lens> block for quality, performance and security in that order; quality retains one current VERDICT line per task contract, and the required boilerplate is preflighted against the helper schema's 3,000-character overall_explanation maximum; oversized output refuses. Unchunked output is the top-level pass; chunked output uses exact nonempty chunk 1/N through chunk N/N reports. Each finding title starts with exactly one `[quality] `, `[performance] `, or `[security] ` token; the helper has one integer line, so start=end=line. Cross-lens duplicate detection uses repo-relative NFC POSIX path, integer start/end lines and NFC/whitespace-collapsed/case-folded title after tag removal. Only verdicts in validated quality assessment blocks count; other lens blocks, finding bodies and synthesized chunk summaries cannot supply them. Projections preserve pass order and reuse existing score, recommendation and worst quality-verdict behavior.
review_contract.upgrade_migration: PORTABLE-DELIVERY-MIGRATION is the only compatibility transition. Before the first target write it globally preflights every eligible fixed set. Active proof binds current task state; sealed proof binds the immutable marker commit and exact fixed bytes. Only then may it create and read back origin=upgrade generations and pointers. A sealed reader accepts a later migration pointer only when the generation's sealed-commit binding exactly equals the marker commit; replacement, mismatch, malformed, mixed, colliding, linked or ambiguous input refuses. Byte-identical retry passes and unbound archives remain display-only.
review_contract.classifier: Reuse factory_lib.product_excluded_prefixes and product_delta_digest for review scope plus current and historical branch-diff paths, and closeout delta_id. Genuine-contribution proof cites a qualifying path and hunk in that same delta and correlates it with admitted write and terminal evidence. No second classifier, branch-diff digest, product-tree snapshot or parallel identity is introduced.
review_contract.rejection: Reject only from the selected origin=combined generation. Create one immutable origin=rejection successor bound to that source generation file SHA256 and ID; preserve exact decoded raw_result bytes, shared bindings, pass order and unaffected lenses; change only the cited projection and record exact finding, reason, citation and actor before pointer-last publication. Rejection, fixed-only, upgrade, unselected or unrelated sources refuse.
review_contract.incumbent_baseline: origin/main c9a705bc runs three lens helpers concurrently, accepts story proof as a task fallback in one reader, and lets task close reuse exact-delta review proof. These are inherited runtime facts, not Decision0069/C10 completion; First replaces generation creation with one helper, removes the task-to-story proof fallback, and reuses the closeout delta seam.
review_contract.schema_shape: Generation shared fields are format,generation_id,origin,generated_by,story,task_id,review_run_id,brief_sha256,inspected_commit,delta_id,helper,input,raw_result,lenses,recorded_at. helper={path,version,sha256}; input={sha256,bytes}; raw_result={encoding:base64,sha256,bytes,data} stores exact pre-parse helper output bytes; lenses has exact quality/performance/security review payloads. combined forbids origin detail; rejection adds source_generation_id/source_generation_sha256/root_generation_id/history; upgrade adds inventory_digest/source_kind/sorted legacy_artifacts/sealed_commit. Selection fields are format,story,task_id,generation_id,generation_sha256,delta_id,selected_at.
